local.aberdeen-city.midstocketrosemount..note: Aberdeen City Council's declaration of results: Jeff Diack (SNP) elected at stage 8 under STV. Electorate 11,768; 3,121 ballot papers received, turnout 26.5%; 33 rejected (30 with a first preference against more than one candidate, 3 unmarked or void), leaving 3,088 first preferences. Quota 1,545. First preferences: Diack (SNP) 861, John (Conservative) 743, Young (Labour) 535, Bird (Scottish Greens) 330, McLeod (Reform UK) 323, Stephen (Lib Dem) 192, Singal (Independent) 67, McLean (Independent) 37. First preferences are not a final-round margin or an FPTP result; this declaration is not forecast-graded.
